name: Diplomatic Attack Against NATO Enlargement (2008) (C0098)

techniques.comment: An attempt to strike a deal with the US leader over Kyiv's head in order to block Ukraine's Euro-Atlantic integration under the threat of its dismemberment: Ukraine's accession to NATO would create "a field of conflict for you and us, long-term confrontation," while Moscow, relying on anti-NATO forces, "would be working on stripping NATO of the possibility of enlarging. Russia would be creating problems there all the time"(Citation: Memorandum of Conversation: Meeting with President of Russia (Sochi) 2008). As retold by Kommersant's source from the summit itself: "You understand, George, that Ukraine is not even a state! What is Ukraine? Part of its territory is Eastern Europe, and part - a considerable part - was gifted by us!" - with a transparent hint "that Russia could begin the severance of Crimea and Eastern Ukraine"(Citation: Блок НАТО разошелся на блокпакеты (Коммерсантъ) 2008).

The deliberate injection of false historical narratives into the international arena: Ukraine, according to the Russian leader, "is not a nation built in a natural manner" and "an artificial country created back in Soviet times," and its territories were supposedly gifts - "In the 1920s and 1930s Ukraine obtained territory from Russia -- that's the eastern part of the country. In 1956, the Crimean peninsula was transferred to Ukraine"(Citation: Memorandum of Conversation: Meeting with President of Russia (Sochi) 2008). From this the thesis of its possible disintegration was derived: "the country could just split apart"(Citation: Memorandum of Conversation: Meeting with President of Russia (Sochi) 2008).
